steps.content: The girl sits in the interrogation chair, entranced and motionless as a real doll.
Eve's eyelashes flutter, but she doesn't lift her head, seemingly unsure of how to interact with you.
An unbreakable icy silence fills the interrogation room.
Her physical injuries from the fire have healed, but the clinic's assessment of her condition is not optimistic.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: She actually wasn't in critical danger. It's a miracle that she survived such a huge fire.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: When the rescue team found her, she was trapped between slabs of stone, unharmed.
After Eve was rescued, she was immediately taken to the nearest Syndican clinic. Upon receiving the news, you also hurried to the clinic.
Eve's life is not in danger, but the doctor's brow remains furrowed.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: We gave her a full examination and found that the most serious issue wasn't caused by the fire.
And... what is the most serious issue?

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: ...How much do you know about her legs?
According to the investigation, her legs were injured in a car accident when she was a child. It has nothing to do with the factory or the Mania contamination.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: But a Sinner typically has an unusually robust body.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: The nerves of a severed limb would have extraordinary vitality. We're talking about a Sinner's body. Even if only the brain is left, it can fuse with a full mechanical prosthetic body.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: According to the examination results, there is no sign of fusion between her prosthetic limbs and the remaining nerves.
You mean she could have been able to stand on her legs?

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Right...
The doctor sighs and hands you a stack of reports.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Her most serious issue is not physical, but psychological.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Why would a person who doesn't want to live want to stand up?
Behind the small surveillance window in the clinic room door, Eve is sitting in her wheelchair by the window, lost in thought. Beside her are the untouched food tray and pills.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: We've confiscated all sharp objects, but still she's tried to take her life several times.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Later, she probably realized her drastic actions might lead to consequences for the clinic. She's since been just sitting there blankly like that.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: She only responds minimally at the sight of you. You might be the only person in this world that she recognizes and is willing to communicate with.
In your pocket, the MBCC's communication device is constantly vibrating. You know there are more important tasks that require your attention.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! The FAC decontamination team has detected an abnormal increase in Mania contamination in the BR-004 blockade area.
I'll be back soon...
Can you clear out my schedule before I set off? It won't take long.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What do you need to do?
I need to talk to Eve.
Eve.
You call her name again, and she finally responds.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Hmm...
Eve seems hesitant to look up still. You dim the light shining in her face so it doesn't dazzle her eyes.
You remember me, don't you?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Of course. You're the gray rag doll. You conveyed the true voices of the family. I'll never forget that.
The first time we talked, I was a rag doll. The second time, you were controlled by Mania. The third time, we're in a place like this.
You're probably not used to this environment, are you?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's okay... It's cold, but it's fine.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I'm used to places like this. The factory deep in the Rust is also chilly. I usually sat in a stiff chair like I do now.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But the place I'm most familiar with is gone now, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's in ruins now, and I'm the only one left...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I've caused trouble for you.
Eve's hands clasp together anxiously. You can feel that she is trying to hide her emotions.
Not just you. In fact, when we found you in the ruins, the rescue team also found some other things.
test
test
test
test
test
test
Covered in ashes from the fire, the broken pieces look no different than a pile of refuse from the Rust. But Eve recognizes them at first glance.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: These are...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The toy family I made?
When we found you, these fragments were piled around you. If I'm not mistaken, they saved you.
Eve seems incredulous, her fingertips trembling as she tries to reach out, then suddenly pulls back.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But they were just toys I made...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I simply assigned them memories and personalities... We were just playing house.
A personality and memories are enough to simulate half a real soul.
It was just playing house to you. But for the toys, these moments were long, real memories, right?
Eve looks at the debris in front of her with a complex expression and bites her lip once.

steps.speaker: Bass
steps.content: Cluck!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: From now on, your name is Bass. You and Benna are the closest. If Benna ever forgets anything, you have to remind him.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: The doll's name will be Polly. Remember, you were once the kindest girl in the world.

steps.speaker: Polly
steps.content: I'm... Polly.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Yes, this is the mother nesting doll, Maresa.
Eve's gaze sweeps over each of them...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Idiots... It happened again. You've ended up like this because of me...
When you gave them their identities, they were destined to protect you just like your previous family did.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Yes, they did the exact same thing... Deceiving me that everything will be fine, then leaving me alone to face the devastating reality...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Do you really want me to wake up? Is it really better to be awake than asleep?
She looks sincerely and confusedly at the disfigured toys in front of her, carefully pulling your sleeve, as if expecting the adult in front of her to provide a mature answer.
Is reality really better...
That irritable teddy bear asked me the same question too. In fact, many people have asked me that...

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Are they all like me?
Well, you have some things in common.
They each have a different story... Losing their closest ones, feeling helpless in the face of other patients' departure, holding onto the wish to eradicate all Corruptors...
Helplessly witnessing an innocent girl transform into a monster, killing someone kind and loyal and regretting it, wanting to save everyone but lacking the power...
Eve senses the change in your mood, her fingers nervously rubbing against your sleeve.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: What happened to these people?
They're all awake and aware of the harsh reality and the fact that what they believe in could all be lies and illusions, but they're still moving forward.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: How do they do it?
With patience. They endure it until one day the lies become truths.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Lies... can become truths...?
She seems to have never anticipated this answer.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: But I've seen it... I've seen people be mocked, abandoned, and forgotten...
Are you calling the wonderful things your family promised you a lie?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Are they not?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Sincere friends and happy families. These don't exist in reality.
I see... Well, I prefer to call these lies ideals.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Ide...als?
The word seems so foreign to Eve.
That's right, Eve. These hopeful expectations aren't mere lies. They present the possibility of change.
That's the meaning of tomorrow. Tomorrow, your perspective and abilities may change, and perhaps you can do something new.
The accumulation of tomorrows gives us the power to make the lies true.
For someone struggling in the dirt, as long as she's still got a tomorrow, the possibility of standing up is always there.
Your smile seems to truly empower her a little. She stares at you quietly for a long time.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Tomorrow. I think I've got one now.
You push those pieces toward Eve.
These are what they earned for you.
Make your choice once more. I'll be waiting for your answer.
More urging calls from your device. You stand up and put on your coat.
Eve holds onto you nervously.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Where are you going, Chief?
Syndicate. A place where violence and crises abound and various forces are constantly at war.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: You're going there even if you know it's dangerous? Are you... leaving me too?
Seeing Eve's hand trembling with uneasiness, you grip it and gently pat it.
I'm going to turn those lies into truths and use the power accumulated from the tomorrows to create a better world for you, and for everyone.
This is my motivation. What's yours, Eve?

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: I've lost... all my motivation...
She lowers her head in confusion, but her hand doesn't let go. She's scared, afraid that you'll leave her alone like her family once did.
Bass and Benna have said it, you're the smartest. I believe you will find your motivation.
Once you do, you'll be able to stand up and walk out of the factory, enduring the pain.
Whether to return to the beautiful dream or to see a new tomorrow, tell me your answer when I come back.
No matter what your answer is, this time, I will support you.
The door of the interrogation room opens from the outside. Nightingale is waiting for your instructions with a team of guards.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The car is ready to take Eve back to the clinic for continued observation and treatment.
Good, we should set off now.
The medical staff enter the interrogation room and help Eve onto the wheelchair, but her gaze follows you the entire time.
That look of incomprehension, shock, and curiosity never leaves you until the door closes.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: What is my motivation...?
